attendances_complete_safety_check.name: attendances_complete_safety_check
attendances_complete_safety_check.value:
("attendances"."fall_hazard" IS NULL AND "attendances"."floor_and_guardrail" IS NULL
        AND "attendances"."protective_equipment" IS NULL AND "attendances"."safety_check_updated_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("attendances"."fall_hazard" IS NOT NULL AND "attendances"."floor_and_guardrail" IS NOT NULL
        AND "attendances"."protective_equipment" IS NOT NULL AND "attendances"."safety_check_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)

sites_center.name: sites_center
sites_center.value:
("sites"."latitude" IS NULL AND "sites"."longitude" IS NULL) OR
      ("sites"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "sites"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND
      "sites"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "sites"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

work_prompt_response.name: work_prompt_response
work_prompt_response.value:
("work_prompts"."response" IS NULL AND "work_prompts"."answered_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("work_prompts"."response" IS NOT NULL AND "work_prompts"."response" IN ('okay','help_needed') AND "work_prompts"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL)

incidents_open_responder_idx.name: incidents_open_responder_idx
incidents_open_responder_idx.where: "incidents"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "incidents"."responder_id" IS NOT NULL
